messages:
alex: Quick ping — I opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/7642 to roll a small runtime tweak + update a k8s manifest and a docs page. PR touches `packages/runtime/`, `infra/k8s/`, and `docs/ops/` — CODEOWNERS doesn't seem to match `infra/k8s/*`. Who is the right approver so I can merge today?

maya: can you paste the changed paths real quick?

alex: sure — diff summary:```
packages/runtime/src/inference/kv_cache.py
packages/runtime/setup.py
infra/k8s/deployments/runtime.yaml
docs/ops/runtime-caching.md
```

sam: infra/k8s normally falls to @eng-infra but our CODEOWNERS pattern is `infra/**` not `infra/k8s/*` so the bot might not auto-request. If it's a tiny manifest tweak I can approve, otherwise ask @lisa (eng-infra lead). :+1:

lisa: I can take a peek, but if the k8s change includes resource or securityContext changes I'll need a bit more context. From the file list it looks small — paste the manifest hunk?

alex: manifest hunk:```yaml
- name: runtime
  resources:
    limits:
      cpu: "2"
      memory: "8Gi"
+ name: runtime
+  resources:
+    limits:
+      cpu: "1.5"
+      memory: "6Gi"
  env:
    - name: KV_CACHE_ENABLED
      value: "true"
```

sam: that looks like a safe scaling/ram tweak, not touching security. @lisa feel free to approve if you're OK. For future: if CODEOWNERS misses the specific dir, you can request review from the team alias (e.g. @eng-infra) and add a short rationale in the PR body so leads can triage quickly.

lisa: ok I'll review and if it's just limits I'll approve. One ask: add a one-line note in PR description about why lowering mem is safe (observability/benchmarking note).

alex: will do. if you approve I'll merge after CI green. thanks!

sre-bot: (automated) this repo requires at least one approver from CODEOWNERS for paths matching `infra/**`. PR currently has 0 required approvers.

maya: note for future PRs — if you're touching runtime + infra + docs in one PR, consider splitting infra changes into a terser PR so infra reviewers can land quickly. Saves context switching.

alex: yea good point — keeping in mind. splitting now would be more churn so I'll wait for @lisa approval and then follow up with a separate docs-only cleanup. Thanks everyone :grinning:
